verdict.rationale: Phaser ships a hosted Game Agent and an MCP server, so scheduling recurring agent jobs or workflows is a plausible question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows one-off, prompt-driven actions (describing changes in plain language, one-click publishing). Nothing documents a recurring schedule, cron-style trigger, or automated workflow runner.
